features: ER605 (TL-R605) Multi-WAN VPN Router: Wired single-band 1000 Mbps router with up to 3 Gigabit WAN ports, SPI firewall, Omada SDN integration, load balancing, and lightning protection for small business networks
VERSATILE WAN CONNECTIVITY: Features 1 dedicated Gigabit WAN port, 2 configurable WAN/LAN ports, and 1 USB port supporting 4G/3G modem for mobile broadband backup
VPN GATEWAY: Supports up to 20 LAN-to-LAN IPsec, 50 OpenVPN, 16 L2TP, and 16 PPTP VPN connections for remote access
PPPOE BRIDGE SUPPORT: Offloads routing from your ISP-provided ONT, allowing the router to handle authentication and receive the public IP directly for better control
OMADA SDN INTEGRATION: Enables Zero-Touch Provisioning, Centralised Cloud Management via the Omada app, and advanced firewall with DoS defence and IP/MAC/URL filtering
MULTI-WAN LOAD BALANCER & FAILOVER: Supports up to 3 ISPs simultaneously, automatically switching traffic to active connections if one fails, helping keep your business online
description: The ER605 is a powerful Gigabit Multi-WAN VPN Gateway router designed to keep your small business connected at all times. With support for up to 3 ISPs simultaneously, the router automatically switches traffic to an active connection if one or two ISPs fail, ensuring uninterrupted internet access. It features 1 dedicated Gigabit WAN port and 2 configurable WAN/LAN ports, enabling load balancing to maximise broadband utilisation. The PPPoE Bridge configuration allows the ER605 to handle authentication directly, giving you full control over your network — ideal for online gaming or hosting services. A USB port supports 4G/3G mobile broadband modems for additional WAN backup. Integrated into the Omada SDN platform, it offers Zero-Touch Provisioning, centralised cloud management, and intelligent monitoring via the Omada app. Security is robust, with support for up to 20 IPsec, 50 OpenVPN, 16 L2TP, and 16 PPTP VPN connections, alongside advanced firewall policies, DoS defence, and IP/MAC/URL filtering to safeguard your network and data.
